rule: Discovery does not create commitment; evidence earns attention.

candidates.reason: Highest-value active empirical programme. The immediate discriminating issue is no longer request throughput but whether decision-time feature values can be reconstructed. Current records and post-decision dumps can otherwise create silent temporal leakage.
candidates.next_discriminating_action: Construct a year-by-field temporal-observability matrix for ICLR 2017-2022. Permit policy inputs only when decision-time state is observed or deterministically derivable; otherwise narrow to submission-time features or ABSTAIN.

candidates.reason: Pair planning, sealed-execution requirements, and a machine-readable execution receipt schema now exist. The remaining validity gap is observational enforcement: receipts must be generated from runtime instrumentation rather than caller assertions.
candidates.next_discriminating_action: Implement an execution adapter that derives receipts from observed runtime events, validates paired receipts against the frozen plan, and refuses analysis on fail or abstain; then run the first admissible pair.

candidates.reason: Conformance evidence cannot establish real-work utility; current field and collaboration research measures task quality, time use, retained capability, or real occupational performance.
evidence: Dillon et al. 2025 randomized field experiment
candidates.next_discriminating_action: Collect independently isolated control/kernel records from pinned equivalent starting states; reject contaminated pairs before analysis.

candidates.reason: Blinded/counterbalanced preparation and a published validity note now separate conformance evidence from consequence claims.
candidates.next_discriminating_action: Use multiple judge families only for conformance; preserve disagreements.

candidates.reason: No longitudinal or sufficiently heterogeneous consequence dataset yet demonstrates net scarcity displacement without downstream regressions.
candidates.next_discriminating_action: Promote only after consequence records show practical benefit with no hard-boundary regression and the result replicates across model/task families.
